title: Occupational Health AI Interpreters for Work Injury Visits
summary: Use AI interpretation in work injury visits to capture injury histories, explain restrictions, protect privacy, and document follow-up clearly.
body_markdown:
###


Verify the task, mechanism, body part and side, date and time, symptom onset, equipment, exposure, immediate response, prior treatment, and current functional limits. Read back details that affect diagnosis or restrictions.


###


Use measurable, approved wording and read back weights, durations, frequencies, body side, shift limits, and reevaluation dates. Ask the patient to explain which tasks are allowed and prohibited.


###


Not automatically. Use the disclosure pathway approved for the claim and jurisdiction. A separate work-status document can communicate capacity and restrictions without automatically duplicating the full clinical record.


###


The clinic should use its approved language access process and avoid assigning the communication role to someone whose workplace role or interests differ. Preserve a direct, private path for the patient to communicate.


###


Yes, with clear audio, verification of laterality and numbers, teach-back, documentation, and a fallback based on patient preference, policy, and encounter needs. The clinic remains responsible for disclosure and work-status decisions.
